content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Postdoctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is 30th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Postdoctoral Fellow role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Postdoctoral Fellow position, candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree in Electronics/Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from a university or institute that is recognized.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee involves two main stages: initial document shortlisting followed by an interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Postdoctoral Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their application and required documents to the official email address provided by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Postdoctoral Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Postdoctoral Fellow position in this recruitment drive by IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Postdoctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: The Postdoctoral Fellow position at IIT Roorkee is a contract-based job.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Roorkee provide age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.
